## Candidate scope

Identify source commit(s), actual contributors, included functionality, dependencies and what is explicitly excluded. Preserve existing license/notices and update PROVENANCE.md / RELEASE_MANIFEST.json.

## Verification

Record only checks actually run. Distinguish source CI, candidate CI, injected fixtures and live acceptance. No additional local product tests or visual review unless the owner authorizes them.

## Remaining work

List missing modules, rights/eligibility review, live-provider acceptance and configuration. A draft publication PR does not authorize deployment, hosted migrations or final submission. Main merge requires owner approval.
